OriginalComment: Northern York-Camp Hill: Those of us who live in Newberry Township, York County currently have a state senator who lives and represents ALL of Lebanon County. To visit us he has to drive thru Lebanon County, Dauphin County and Cumberland County before he reaches York County. How can someone who lives that far away truly represent those he has nothing in common with? We feel like bastard children in our state Senate.

Name: Karns City Area School District

OriginalComment: Karns City Area School District: This collection of people are a part of the Karns City Area School District, or are just outside the school district and still have children that go to Karns City High School or related elementary schools. Our community takes pride in what high school they went to, or where their kids go to, so it makes sense for them to all be within the same Representative or Senator in Harrisburg.

Clarion Borough, Clarion County, Pa. 16214: Small college town in an economically declining community. Many challenges. Clarion University is one of the final large employers, as is the local Hospital. The Downtown is in decline, as are the roads in Clarion Borough. It my hope that the University does not continue to downsize. It would be devastating for our community.
